name: Back to Blocks (Slabs & Stairs to Block)
summary: Lets you convert slabs and stairs back into their full block. Covers nearly every slab and stair type.

vanilla_changes.change: 2 identical slabs side by side (shaped, one row of two) -> 1 full block. Covers wood planks (incl. bamboo and bamboo mosaic), stone, cobblestone and mossy variants, stone/brick types, deepslate, tuff, blackstone, prismarine, purpur, quartz, sandstone and red sandstone (incl. cut and smooth), nether bricks, mud bricks, end stone bricks, and every cut copper stage including waxed.
4 identical stairs (shapeless) -> 3 full blocks of the same type. Same families as the slab list, minus cut sandstone, cut red sandstone and smooth stone, which have no stairs.

getting_started: Craft in a normal crafting table (or furnace where noted); recipes appear in the recipe book once the ingredients are held.
editor_notes: Counts from datapack: 60 slab recipes, 58 stair recipes. With the stair recipe in the minecraft module (6 blocks -> 8 stairs), 4 stairs -> 3 blocks is the exact reverse ratio.
